title: NODE — Fifty Seven

features.name: the barrel, down to ashen splinters
features.desc-on-touch: The fire reduced, while the stars play act as embers on the roof.

features.name: blue dots on a bicep
features.desc-on-touch: As many as the sky has tiny fiery holes. Not washed off in the river the next morning.

features.name: a question about the river module
features.desc-on-touch: He asks whether the one down by the river has Bell-Birds on it. Quit stalling, she says. Just go with your gut.

features.name: a train window, all these years on
features.desc-on-touch: Fifty seven finger jabs, tapped into the glass. Three times nineteen. Still not a prime.

inscription: prime, I tell Katita in the dark

file.name: Primes_tapped.txt
file.note: 2 3 5 7 11 13 17 19 23. Then 57, entered in biro and answered correctly by luck.

reverie.title: REVERIE — a dirt courtyard, the fire nearly out
narr: Twenty three taps on the skin. Prime, you told her in the dark.
Good, she said, and began again with her biro against your bicep.
You counted fifty seven and wondered about ink poisoning.
No, you said, it is not a prime. Lucky guess, Grothendieck.
She kissed you on the cheek.
You did not wash the ink off in the river the next morning.

exits.label: down to the river in the morning
